flyer.justification: Adheres perfectly to flyer criteria with clean formatting and appropriate TBA placeholders, though it focuses mostly on high-level concepts.

instagram.justification: Follows all Instagram requirements including carousel cues, call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: Well-structured conversational email, though the subject line slightly exceeds the 50-character limit.

linkedin.justification: Well-written post with a good narrative hook, but fails to include the required 3-5 hashtags.

summary.justification: Meets all word count and structural requirements for an executive briefing, framing the talk effectively for a business audience.

blog.justification: Thoroughly covers all key points of the talk with clear analysis, though it lacks a dedicated 'About the Author' section at the end.
